text: The Offeror must ensure that all products included in the quote packet comply with the Buy American Act, the Trade Agreement Act, and all relevant clauses found in the FAR and any agency-specific regulations. text: An end product is compliant if it is a Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) item, defined as a commercial product that is sold in substantial quantities in the commercial marketplace and offered to the Government, under a contract or subcontract at any tier, without modification, in the same form in which it is sold in the commercial marketplace, and does not include bulk cargo (such as agricultural or petroleum products as defined in 46 U.S.C. 40102(4)); or, if the end product consists wholly or predominantly of iron or steel or a combination of both, it is manufactured in the United States and the cost of foreign iron and steel constitutes less than 5 percent of the cost of all components used in the end product. For the purposes of this requirement, 'predominantly' means the cost of the iron and steel content exceeds 50 percent of the total cost of all its components. The cost of iron and steel includes the cost of iron or steel mill products (such as bar, billet, slab, wire, plate, or sheet), castings, or forgings used in manufacture, and a good faith estimate of the cost of all foreign iron or steel components excluding COTS fasteners, where iron or steel components of unknown origin are treated as foreign. Steel is defined as an alloy that includes at least 50 percent iron and between 0.02 and 2 percent carbon, and may include other elements.
